verdict.rationale: Runway documents native 1080p generation: Seedance 2.5 and Kling 4.0 output 1080p, and drafts can be enhanced to 1080p. Plans include 4K upscaling, and Gen-4.5 and Aleph 2.0 can export ProRes, PNG sequences and HDR profiles directly, so the resolution side of the story is covered in-product. Nothing in the pack documents choosing 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 output, and there is no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documented aspect-ratio selection (16:9/9:16/1:1), confirmation that channel-ready formats need no external re-encoding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding

citations.quote: at 720p or 1080p for up to 30 seconds
Studio-grade quality generations: HDR, ProRes, image sequences
